title: They Bullied The Quiet Nerd . . . Big Mistake (Episode 1)
caption:
They bullied the quiet top student for weeks... then they touched his grades 😳 Weak Hero Class 1, episode 1. Follow for episode 2!

#weakhero #kdrama #kdramarecap #movierecap #recap #spoilerroom #fyp
comment: Was Sam right to go that far, or did he cross the line? 👀 Comment below 👇

segments.say: The quiet kid with the best grades in school just put his bully on the *floor*.
And all he used was *physics*.

segments.text: Newton's second law. Force equals mass times acceleration.

segments.say: Thirteen days earlier. Meet Sam. Top of his class, first place in math, and he never *talks*.
No friends, no fights. Just study, study, *study*.
But his class has a gang. They film a weak kid dancing, and laugh while he *begs*.
Then one of them threw a ball, and it hit Sam in the *head*.
Oh, sorry, they laughed. Keep *studying*.
The whole room went silent. Nobody talks back to Victor's gang. *Nobody*.
Victor leaned in. You know what? Everyone *hates* you.
Sam didn't even look up. Are you bored? You could have learned another English word by *now*.
In the same class sits Max. He sleeps all day on a pink pillow, and nobody *touches* him.
When the whole baseball team came for him, he took them all down, *alone*.
And he didn't even break a *sweat*.
In gym class, Sam ran until he almost *collapsed*.
The gang watched him, and smiled. We need to beat the hell out of him *soon*.
In the locker room, Victor grabbed Sam by the *neck*.
Say it politely. Let me *go*.
A teacher walked in. Sam could have told him *everything*.
But he just said, we were playing *around*.
That night, a delivery guy knocked on his door. It was *Max*.
Wrong building. But Max begged for water like he was *dying*.
Sam gave him a glass. I'll buy you three bottles *tomorrow*. Something new had *started*.
Then a new kid joined the class. Bobby. Quiet, glasses, from a rich *school*.
Meanwhile, Victor was angry. Nothing they did would *break* Sam.
Then he found the answer. His grades. He's nuts about his grades. Let's mess with *that*.
That night, Victor met a dealer, and asked one question. What happens if you put a fentanyl patch on someone's *skin*?
You'd get dizzy, sleepy, and maybe throw *up*.
The next day, Victor found Bobby's secret. At his old school, he was beaten so badly he had to *transfer*.
I'll keep your secret, he smiled. But you owe me a small *favor*.
He put something in Bobby's hand. *Take* it.
Mock test day. Bobby sat right behind *Sam*.
There was a bug on your neck, he said. And his hand *touched* Sam's neck.
Minutes later, the paper started to *spin*.
Sam's head dropped. Sweat poured down his face. He couldn't even read the *questions*.
He ran out of the room, and felt something on his neck. A *patch*.
Barely awake, he went back and finished the *test* anyway.
When it was over, Bobby turned around. It's not what you *think*.
Sam didn't say a word. He walked straight to *Victor*.
Victor laughed. You're crazy. Then Sam swung his desk *chair*.
Spin, speed, and force. Every hit landed like a *hammer*.
Victor hit the floor, bleeding. I told you to *stop*.
Then a voice from the door. Don't cross the line. Know when to *stop*.
It was Max. Who are *you*?

segments.text: I'm like your guardian angel who just woke up from a nap.

segments.say: The quiet nerd and the strongest guy in school just met for real. And Victor's gang is not done with them *yet*.
